description: Canonical contract examples for VibeCheck API endpoints and data models

finding_example.title: Hardcoded Production API Secret Detected
finding_example.evidence: Stripe live secret key literal matched regex pattern 'sk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{24}'
finding_example.impact: Exposing production API keys directly in client-side code enables attackers to execute unauthorized financial transactions and drain accounts.
finding_example.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets from client-accessible source code. Move sensitive operations to a backend server and load credentials from environment variables.
verification_steps: Confirm the secret is purged from the codebase and git history.
Rotate the compromised Stripe key in the Stripe Dashboard.
Verify the client fetches data via authenticated backend endpoints instead of using direct secret keys.

findings.title: Permissive Wildcard CORS Configuration
findings.evidence: CORS origin set to '*' with credentials enabled
findings.impact: Allows arbitrary third-party websites to make authenticated cross-origin requests to your backend endpoints, exposing private user data.
findings.recommendation: Specify explicit trusted origins in CORS configuration instead of wildcard '*', and restrict allowed methods and headers.
verification_steps: Update CORS config to accept only approved frontend origins (e.g. process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN).
Send an Options preflight request from an untrusted origin and verify it is rejected.

scan_response_example.repair_prompt:
You are a senior security engineer. Fix the following vulnerabilities identified in sample-vibe-storefront:
1. [Critical] Hardcoded Production API Secret Detected in src/api/client.js:12. Remove the hardcoded 'sk_live_...' key, replace with process.env.STRIPE_SECRET accessed only on the server, and revoke the old key.
2. [High] Permissive Wildcard CORS Configuration in server.js:25-27. Replace wildcard '*' origin with an explicit whitelist loaded from environment configuration.
limitations: Static heuristics and pattern rules only; runtime dynamic execution not performed.
Third-party npm package internal code inside node_modules was excluded from deep AST analysis.
